column1: # The RS232 transceiver is intentionally unused by this example.
# Normal firmware boots from ota_0/ota_1. The inactive slot is used for
# power-fail-safe shell OTA; the configuration record stays at its historical
# address so existing field configuration data remains compatible.
# esp-bootloader-esp-idf 0.5.0 assumes every partition has a recognized
# core type and panics while scanning application-defined types (0x40-0xfe).
